info.prompt: A cybernetic altar of bone and light glows under the flicker of an unseen neural storm, its structure a fusion of gothic arches and circuit-board veins. Twelve sealed tiles pulse with increasing intensity as conditions near fulfillment, their translucent surfaces refracting Neon Cyan into geometric patterns across the player's hands. The HUD slots burn crimson with unbanked points, their outer glow synchronizing with the 120 BPM rhythm of an invisible bassline. Vignette shadows cling to the edges of the frame, drawing focus toward the central board where a Combo Frenzy erupts in saturated visual chaos.
